verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator with a software stack, and that stack could plausibly ship a natural-language control interface, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only Docker images, PyTorch, DeepSpeed, vLLM and model serving, none of which documents operating the product through natural-language commands. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI all returned 404, so there is no AI-native interface surface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
